python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0047.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let find the corners of the front white face:
# Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
# The front face is a polygon. Let find its boundary:
white = np.argwhere((img[300:430, 180:350, 0] > 240) & (img[300:430, 180:350, 1] > 240) & (img[300:430, 180:350, 2] > 240))
white[:, 0] += 300
white[:, 1] += 180

print("White face u range:", white[:, 1].min(), white[:, 1].max())
print("White face v range:", white[:, 0].min(), white[:, 0].max())

# Bottom edge profile:
for u in range(white[:, 1].min(), white[:, 1].max()+1, 10):
    col = white[white[:, 1] == u]
    print(f"u={u}: min_v={col[:, 0].min()}, max_v={col[:, 0].max()}")
'
